jobs.title: Program Coordinator- Oakland, CA
jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Program Coordinator provides operational, administrative, and customer support to ensure the effective delivery of homecare services for PACE programs. This role focuses on supporting caregivers (HCPs), clients, and internal teams by managing onboarding/offboarding, compliance tracking, communication, and client relations. The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring caregivers are prepared and supported, client needs are met, and all processes remain compliant and efficient.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  
1. Assist caregivers with onboarding, orientation, credentialing, and system access.
  
2. Provide ongoing support to field staff by addressing questions, resolving issues, and ensuring they have the resources needed for successful assignments.
  
3. Maintain accurate and current records of caregiver credentials, certifications, and licensures.
  
4. Communicate updates, policy changes, and assignment details clearly and promptly.
  
5. Support HCPs with timekeeping, payroll, and schedule confirmations.
  
1. Manage HCP timekeeping issues (e.g., missed punches, errors) and review timecards for processing to ensure accuracy and time corrections in a timely manager to avoid payment errors.
  
1. Serve as a primary contact for PACE program clients, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.
  
2. Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure service satisfaction.
  
3. Conduct periodic client satisfaction checks and follow up on feedback to improve service delivery.
  
4. Ensure client-specific requirements, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and shared with caregivers.
  
5. Work with Compliance team to ensure caregiver are compliant with all regulatory, licensing, and agency standards.
  
6. Maintain and update databases, internal systems, and client portals with accurate caregiver and client information.
  
7. Support audits by ensuring complete and accurate documentation is available when needed.
  
8. Generate, prepare, and distribute reports for internal teams and client review.
  
9. Assist with creating confirmation letters, client-facing communications, and process documentation.
  
10. Act as a liaison between caregivers, clients, and internal departments to ensure alignment and issue resolution.
  
11. Communicate clearly and consistently with all stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.
  
12. Provide backup coverage for colleagues to ensure uninterrupted clients and caregiver support.
  
13. Represent Cross Country Healthcare with professionalism and integrity in all interactions.
  
14. May be required to attend offsite job fairs and community events as needed.
  
15. May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
  
16. Other duties as assigned
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
1. Minimum of one (1) year of administrative or client support experience, preferably in healthcare or staffing.
  
2. Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to handle multiple priorities.
  
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  
5. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  
6. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all situations.
  
7. Experience with VMS technology or client portals.
  
8. Bilingual skills preferred.
  
9. Strong problem-solving and relationship-building abilities.
  
**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Some college preferred.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition Assistance, and Pet Insurance. The company offers a variety of Wellness options through Burnalong, which offers a robust online platform of classes and programs as well as local gym access.
  
  
Cross Country is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) - Veteran/Disability

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Program Coordinator is the primary administrative support for the local site. During recruitment, program coordinators manage incoming nominations, the interview schedule, and student personal information through Salesforce. Additionally, program coordinators provide logistical support for each phase of the interview process, as well as the Award Ceremony, and often take the lead in organizing volunteers. During Pre-Collegiate Training, program coordinators play a key role in managing the Writing Program and coordinate logistics for special events such as summer retreats and the Posse Olympics. In support of the Campus Program, program coordinators collect and organize student data and assist program directors in producing regular reports. Program Coordinators also manage travel logistics and supplies for special events on campus. In addition to these responsibilities, program coordinators provide general support for the local office such as managing calendars, tracking office supplies, answering phones, and welcoming students and guests. The program coordinator reports directly to the program director of the site.

* Bachelor’s Degree required
* Excellent writing skills
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to multi-task
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Excellent time-management skills
* Experience with youth is a plus
* Ability to work well with college students
* Able to work autonomously and within a team
* Event management experience a plus
* Proficiency required in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, internet and email
* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign and MS Access a plus
* Proficiency/Knowledge of Salesforce a plus
* Knowledge of design software
* Bilingual a plus
* Demonstrated belief in Posse’s mission and values

jobs.title: Aerial Arts Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Los Gatos Elite's Aerial Arts program has a strong lead coach and a solid support staff. What we need now is someone to round out the team: a capable coach who also enjoys the organizational side of running a program.

Our aerial program includes:

* Recreational Aerial Silks
* Recreational Aerial Hoop/Lyra
* Competitive/Performance Hoop and Fabric

You'll coach across these levels and take ownership of the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the program running — scheduling, registrations, parent communication, and competition logistics — in partnership with our lead coach and LGE leadership.

**What your week looks like**

* **10–12 hours coaching** – recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes, plus support for competitive/performance team training
* **3–5 hours admin** – class rosters and scheduling, parent emails, competition registrations and entry fees, travel planning, showcase and event coordination
* **Travel for competitions** – accompany the team to aerial competitions and performances (dates shared in advance)

**Responsibilities**

* Coach recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes with safe, consistent progressions
* Assist the lead coach with competitive/performance training, conditioning, and act preparation
* Maintain the aerial class schedule, rosters, and enrollment records
* Serve as a primary point of contact for aerial families on schedules, fees, and competition details
* Manage competition registrations, entry fees, travel arrangements, and day-of logistics
* Coordinate with support coaches on coverage and class needs
* Follow and reinforce LGE's safety and rigging standards
* Represent LGE's culture of respect, growth, and teamwork with athletes, families, and staff

**What we're looking for**

* Solid experience in aerial silks/fabric and hoop/lyra as a coach and/or performer
* Experience coaching youth, from beginners through competitive/performance level
* Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable with email, spreadsheets, and scheduling tools
* Someone who likes being the person who keeps things on track
* Working knowledge of aerial rigging and safety practices
* Available for competition travel, including some weekends
* Choreography or performance experience a plus
* Must pass and maintain a green light background check; CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain) required
* Must be able to stoop, bend, climb, and lift 50 pounds overhead

**Why LGE**

Los Gatos Elite is a gymnastics, ninja, and aerial training academy with a close-knit coaching team and a culture built on perpetual growth, respect, and teamwork. This is a role with real responsibility and a clear path to grow as the program does. Our aerialists perform in LGE's annual Showcase alongside our gymnastics and ninja athletes.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.company: Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco Inc.
jobs.title: Temporary Prevention Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***Full-time, Temporary Position***

***Position Status:*** *This is a full-time, temporary position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension or transition to a permanent position based on program needs and funding availability. Extension or transition to permanent status is not guaranteed.*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Principal Program Coordinator (Coordinator)

**Reports To**: Prevention Program Manager

**Program Description:** The Prevention Education Program is a comprehensive substance use prevention program that includes 3 core interventions: Communities Mobilizing for Change on Alcoholism (CMCA), Strengthening Families Program (SFP), Botvin LifeSkills Program (LST) and outreach activities.

**Position Description:** The Coordinator will be trained and responsible for facilitating groups for the 3 core interventions (CMCA, LST, SFP) according to the contract requirements and program needs. Key duties and responsibilities include outreach and recruitment, group facilitation, family engagement, data collection, reporting, etc. As part of the Prevention Team and work with the CMCA groups, the Coordinator will also participate in the COUN-SEL Coalition meetings and events as well as contribute broader prevention efforts as assigned.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop outreach materials and conduct outreach and recruitment for the Strengthening Families Program, with a focus on engaging African American/Black and Spanish-speaking families, as well as for Botvin LifeSkills, CMCA, and other Prevention services.
* Coordination of service provision for each intervention.
* Schedule, plan, and conduct participant orientations for admission and enrollment.
* Co-facilitate the Parent/Youth/Family components of the Strengthening Families program.
* Facilitate and lead Botvin Lifeskills program and CMCA cohorts onsite or at local school sites.
* Maintain youth files for all program participants, each cycle, as needed.
* Maintain detailed records of program attendance/services for reporting and submit monthly reports.
* Enter program services data into a tracking sheet within 24 hrs of activity.
* Reconcile data on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Attend weekly program meetings, monthly All Staff meetings, and other meetings including funding source meetings.
* Maintain a programmatic budget.
* Implement program evaluations to measure the impact of delivery of services (i.e client satisfaction surveys, pre and post tests, etc.).
* Complete mandatory state compliance and other training.
* Support agency wide efforts which includes participation in 1-2 community wide committees/collectives that support the overall program mission and organizational values.
* Other duties assigned by the Prevention Program Manager.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in social sciences or related field and/or 2+ years experience providing direct services for youth.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate youth groups.
* Commitment to learn environmental prevention work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and juggle multiple competing deadlines/tasks in a fast paced environment.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily attendance, hours tracking. monthly and quarterly reports, etc.
* Experience using Zoom, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Classroom, etc.), Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and other relevant software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Job Requirements:**

* Must be able to work evenings, on weekends, and before normal business hours (10:00am-6:30pm or 12-8:30 on SFP Program evenings) for events, outreach, and training.
* Must clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Commitment to complete all required annual training, including environmental prevention training.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.
* If the position becomes permanent, it will become subject to the SEIU Local 1021 Collective Bargaining Agreement, and the employee will be required to enroll in accordance with the applicable agreement.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* As a temporary position, this position is not eligible for Horizons’ health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits, except for benefits required by applicable law.
* **If the position becomes permanent, the employee will become eligible for Horizons’ benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance, effective on the first of the month following one full month of continuous employment, as well as paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and professional development opportunities, subject to applicable eligibility requirements.**
* Hourly wages range from $28.37 to $29.22.

Date Posted: **October 8, 2026**

Application Deadline: **Open Until Filled.**

jobs.description:
**Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career**

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. **US Fertility**, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the **hope we inspire in our patients**, the **lives we help bring into the world**, and the **culture of excellence we foster across our organization.** We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers—including **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area**—we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.

**Opportunity Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Patient Navigator** to join our team at **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area** in **Menlo Park, California.**

* **Schedule:**Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, one weekend per month and two to three holidays per year
* **Compensation:**$35 to $43 per hour (commensurate with experience)

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.  
  
**How You’ll Contribute**

At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work. There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach. Whether collaborating with more than **200 highly respected physicians nationwide** or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the **Patient Navigator** will:

* Meet with established patients and assists with coordination of pretreatment requirements in conjunction with physician orders
* Provide patient education regarding clarification of physician instructions, medication instruction, and anticipatory guidance under the supervision of the RN
* Establish a compassionate environment by providing excellent customer service, anticipating anxieties, answering questions, providing support
* Assure quality care by adhering to Practice standards; follows clinical operations policies and procedures, as well as standards of care set by the state and other governing agency regulations
* Documents patient care services by charting in patient and department records including the electronic medical record (EMR)
* Utilize the computer in entering labs and printing labels
* Maintain safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations, and calling for assistance from other health care support if needed
* Scan forms, records, and other information as needed into the EMR
* Be responsible for generating and maintaining patient pretreatment requirements in conjunction with clinical protocols
* Communicate with financial coordinator to ensure authorizations obtained prior to starting treatment; Assist with completing and routing needed insurance forms (i.e., insurance questionnaires); Send results to financial coordinator and/or insurance plan as needed
* Utilize scheduling system for purposes of managing the primary physician’s schedule and scheduling patients for the primary physician
* Communicate problems to the primary clinical team, i.e. pretreatment or financial concerns
* Review patient records for completion of prescreening inclusive of medical history, appropriate laboratory work, and informed consent
* Check that consents are current and entered into the EMR; Inform patient/couple of consents needing to be updated
* Assist in obtaining authorizations for medications; Communicates with insurance plans and pharmacies to ensure patient able to obtain medications in timely manner
* Document laboratory results in the EMR checklists after review the by RN and/or physician
* Document delivery data in the EMR; Review lists for team’s patients needing delivery data entry and notifies RN/assists RN with collection
* Prepare patient information packets, as needed
* Assist team with correspondence and other administrative tasks, as needed
* Contribute to the upkeep of office equipment and daily “operational” functions within the office. (i.e. fax, printer, mail, filing, coping)

**What You’ll Bring**

We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

**Qualifications and Skills Include:**

* High school diploma required; 1 year experience in medical or healthcare setting (women’s health experience a plus)
* Medical or clinical training (MA, LVN) preferred. If LVN, current state LVN license without limitations required
* Patient Navigator with MA or LPN responsibilities: Current CPR certification or CPR Certification acquired within 1 month of employment
* Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer
* Knowledge of office procedure and office machines (i.e. computer, fax, copier, etc.)
* Ability to demonstrate good judgment, critical thinking, and problem solving abilities
* Ability to function as a member of a multi-disciplinary healthcare team
* Ability to communicate accurately and concisely
* Excellent interpersonal skills and patient orientation
* Ability to work independently to manage a caseload of patients

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations** **Manager**
--------------------------

**Position Classification**: Exempt, full-time, benefits eligible

**Accountable to:** Program Director

**Operations Manager Position Description:**

Under the direct supervision of the Program Director, the Operations Manager (OM) works collaboratively with all staff to facilitate and supervise the orchestration of daily operations related to client treatment and care on behalf of the Program Director and clinical team under the auspices of all prevailing Pathway Society policies and procedures. The Operations Manager reports and documents major incidents and concerns around documentation, workflow, client needs, staff performance, and crisis interventions to the director. The OM is a problem solver who can delegate, resolve, direct and instruct staff and clients in a respectful, positive, and goal-oriented fashion. The Operations Manager is responsible for the initial mediation, crisis prevention/intervention and maintaining *daily* workflow. While the OM is the first contact in the milieu, they do not create, change, or decide the interpretation of policies, curriculum, infractions, discharges, or staff disciplinary actions.

**Operations Manager Primary Responsibilities**:

* Work with care coordinators (CC), withdrawal management staff, reception, and intake to refine client movement and communication amongst team members and clients.
* Work with clinical teams to manage CCs client relationships.
* Report and answer directly to program director on daily issues and concerns related to CC, counselors, and client care.
* Collaborate with clinical supervisor daily to assist clinical team.

* Assist in facilitating medical needs for staff and clients with nurse and doctor in a timely fashion; communicate with medical, clinical and transport for client daily concerns; and Organize med and transport and fill in as needed.
* Conduct daily facility inspections for cleanliness, general condition, and damage.
* Be an ambassador by being visible for client and staff contact within the milieu.
* Broadly ensure the status of linen, toiletries, sanitation supplies and collaborate with culinary staff for any emerging needs.
* Collaborate and assist clinical, medical, intake and WM needs with county services, RR/OP, health agencies as needed including ALOC, transition, and referrals.
* Facilitate peer groups as necessary during clinical team absence or clinical crisis interventions.
* On a periodic basis, fill in during emergency scheduling issues that have no other staffing resolution available.
* Inspect CC work for compliance with PSI documentation and required paperwork.

Conduct shift change meetings (counselors train CC on techniques for client interaction).

* Refine daily client schedule to remove obstacles for groups, meals, breaks, transit, family visits, and drop offs.
* Review daily LOG of scheduled events not in the daily client treatment schedule and coordinate activities as necessary.
* Navigate and delegate daily crisis concerns with staff and resolve issues for staff to maintain workflow, client care, and productivity.
* Recognize initial conflicts with staff, clients and staff, client to client relations, and direct them to clinical team or director for resolution as necessary.
* Document all incidents with staff and/or clients and refer to the program director.
* Report any breech PSI policies by staff or clients to director; concerns with staff needs; and infractions and disciplinary issues.
* Monitor staff and client compliance within PSI policies, paperwork, procedures and intervene with redirection towards proper interaction, procedure, compliance, and workflow.
* Under the direction and guidance of the program director, create a training binder and maintain weekly staff training for procedures and paperwork, emotional regulation strategies, motivational interviewing trauma-informed techniques, meeting people where they are at, positive employee behavior, navigating technology, and professional affect policies.
* Under direction of the program director, consolidate PSI paperwork to decrease confusing clutter and increase workflow performance.
* Audit client case files for county compliance as necessary and directed.

**Operation Manager Qualifications:**

* Clinical experience and degree required
* CADC/equiv. and/or Bachelor's degree required
* Experience working with mental health and substance use disorder populations required.
* Ability to work peacefully and cooperatively as a member of the team.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills including use of computerized word and electronic health record data base.
* Ability to work effectively with people differing in value systems, ethnicity, cultural backgrounds, language capabilities, and disabilities.
* Mastery of utilizing tact and diplomacy in disputes; exercising good judgment; and responding calmly in emergency situations.
* Must pass comprehensive background check, reference check, and possess a valid driver license, current auto liability insurance and a clean driving record.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; climb stairs; walk; use hands to finger, handle, and type and occasionally lift supplies, up to 20 pounds.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, activities and scheduled shift may change at any time, with or without notice.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Utility Design)
jobs.description:
**OPERATIONS MANAGERAbout Radius Design**

Radius Design is a growing Bay Area utility design and consulting firm specializing in dry utility, electric, gas, and joint trench design. We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to help us build efficient systems, improve coordination, and keep our growing organization running smoothly.

**The Opportunity**

The Operations Manager owns the day-to-day operations of the company, working under the COO and closely with leadership, project management, engineering, design, and administration to ensure our people, processes, priorities, and resources are aligned.

This is a heavily operations-driven leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, creating structure, improving processes, and bringing clarity to ambiguous situations. The ideal candidate is an influential, solutions-oriented leader who can bring teams together, make thoughtful decisions, lead change, and remain calm when things get complicated.

**If you are someone who can bring calm to complexity, turn ambiguity into clarity, and help both people and operations work better, we’d love to hear from you.**

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the COO and leadership team on operational strategy, organizational needs, and company-wide initiatives.
* Lead organizational and process changes by creating clear expectations, communicating effectively, and ensuring follow-through.
* Identify complex operational problems, determine root causes, and develop practical solutions that improve how teams and processes work together.

**Overview**
------------

Intuit’s Mid-Market organization is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Generation Analyst to drive deep insights across the demand generation funnel. This role will be responsible for analyzing performance from first touch through lead routing and handoff, identifying leakage, uncovering trends, and ensuring every lead is properly tracked, routed, and acted upon. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical rigor, operational curiosity, and a passion for improving funnel efficiency through data-driven insights

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze the end-to-end demand generation funnel for Intuit’s Mid-Market business, from lead creation through routing, acceptance, and downstream outcomes.
* Identify funnel leakage, drop-offs, and inefficiencies, and clearly quantify the business impact of gaps in process, execution, or data.
* Conduct deep-dive analyses into lead routing and disposition, ensuring leads are correctly assigned, tracked, and followed through to resolution.
* Develop and maintain reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into funnel health, conversion rates, velocity, and lead outcomes.
* Partner closely with B2B Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales teams to diagnose issues, validate findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyze trends over time to surface emerging risks, opportunities, and shifts in lead behavior or performance.
* Ensure data integrity across systems (e.g., marketing automation, CRM), proactively flagging discrepancies, data loss, or process breakdowns.
* Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready narratives that inform prioritization and decision-making.
* Support experimentation and optimization efforts by measuring the impact of campaigns, routing logic changes, and process improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, Economics, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, demand generation analytics, revenue operations, or a related analytical role.
* Strong understanding of B2B demand generation funnels, lead lifecycle management, and sales handoff processes.
* Advanced proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua).
* Demonstrated ability to investigate ambiguous problems, trace issues across systems, and identify root causes.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for data accuracy and outcomes.

**Business Operations Manager**

**CIRCE Technology & Research, Business Development**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program Description**

CIRCE Technology & Research is a Salesforce consulting and product firm serving nonprofit, behavioral health, and human services organizations. CIRCE is a registered Salesforce ISV Partner and Consulting Partner and has been in the Salesforce partner program since 2011. CIRCE is a wholly owned subsidiary of Felton Institute.

CIRCE serves the Felton Institute along with sixteen external community-based organizational clients across five service lines: Salesforce consulting and development including Agentforce, systems migrations, the CIRCE Software App for Care and Case Management, Crisis Response Solutions for 988 contact centers and mobile crisis dispatch, and Managed IT Services.

* Clean up and deduplicate records to keep data reliable.
* Build reports and dashboards for internal use and for clients.
* Complete entry-level Salesforce configuration and support tasks on behalf of the delivery team.

* Assist with monthly client invoicing and annual license invoicing.
* Support the Stripe integration with Harvest and its ongoing use for billing.
* Help design and maintain a client numbering system.
* File processed invoices digitally in CIRCE's designated document system.
* Support financial and compliance audits by locating and preparing documentation.

**Business Development and Research**

* Obtain client testimonials and case study material.
* Monitor and manage CIRCE's shared email inbox.
* Maintain CIRCE's online booking page.

jobs.title: Fire Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**About BurnBot**  
BurnBot provides systematic fuels treatment services to prevent destructive wildfires. We're firefighters, scientists, engineers, prescribed fire practitioners, ecologists, and community members who are answering the call to scale fuel treatment capacity. Our modern fuel treatment system recognizes and supports conservation efforts with a clean, smoke-free process. We need technology to amplify our workforces with targeted use of synthetic fire to treat fuel loads 10x faster than previously possible.

  

**The Role**  
BurnBot is seeking a Fire Operations Specialist (FOS) to perform middle leadership oversight within the Fire Program. This role mixes supervisory oversight of BurnBot Fire Modules with responsibility for field-based project operational oversight as well as performing client-focused tasks.

  

This role, while in the field a majority of the time, may be based in Placerville, CA, Medford, OR, or our South San Francisco, CA Headquarters.

  

Administrative tasks include day to day management of 5-person Fire Modules. The FOS will have primary responsibility for recruitment and retention of 1-3 Modules as well as performing supervisory duties including onboarding, ensuring administrative tasks are carried out to BurnBot standards, providing performance feedback, coordinating training, and providing direction leadership in lieu of the Module Leader when they are unavailable. The FOS will help to coordinate Module mobilizations as well as their own in coordination with other FOS and Fire overhead.

  

Field based tasks will include:

* Planning for and/or execution of prescribed fire (broadcast burning, pile burning, air curtain burning, RX2/PFV burning, etc)
* Module leadership for wildfire mobilization and/or mobilization coordination across multiple types of equipment (Type 5 or 6 engines, chippers, heavy equipment, etc)
* Conducting or coordinating Defensible Space Inspections
* The FOS is expected to serve as a project manager/POC or Burn Boss for field projects and maintain a consistent field presence to support Fire Modules, evaluate conditions, and ensure alignment between planning and execution.

* Performs job walks and field verification for proposal building
* In coordination with organizational stakeholders, ensure all projects comply with OSHA, environmental regulations, and fire requirements
* Maintains day-to-day relationship touchpoints at the site and project level
* Captures issues early and escalates effectively through the Fire Director staff or Program leads
* Maintains project artifacts including scope documentation, maps/GIS inputs, schedules, and acceptance checklists
* Other duties as assigned

  

Administrative Tasks:

* Customer management including developing and maintaining relationships with current and potential clients.
* Help to develop proposal budgets, project implementation schedules, and scopes of work.
* Unique skills and qualifications that the FOS possesses will be incorporated into their workload as needed for related BurnBot work.

  

The FOS splits time approximately 40/60% between administrative responsibilities and field engagement. This role serves as the critical operational bridge between Fire Modules and the Director Staff level.

  

This is an exempt role with a salary of $123,000 to $140,000 per year. Placement within the range depends on experience, certifications, and skills.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Directly oversee and support Fire Modules across multiple crews and/or project sites including directly managing modules as needed
* Ensure consistent execution of company standards related to safety, quality, productivity, and professionalism
* Provide guidance, direction, and corrective action to Fire Module leadership
* Maintain oversight of safety performance across all assigned operations
* Ensure compliance with burn plans, project plans, safety policies, and regulatory requirements
* Review incidents, near misses, and safety reports; implement corrective actions and improvements
* Reinforce stop-work authority and risk management expectations at all levels
* Own and manage all required operational reporting (i.e. Production, Safety, Equipment, Labor, Budget, etc.)
* Participate in job walks, pre-bid site visits, and scope development
* Support long-range operational planning, including staffing needs, equipment acquisition, and seasonal workload balancing
* Serve as a primary point of contact between field operations and BurnBot Directors
* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to travel extensively (up to 60%)
* Valid driver's license and ability to be insured under company policy (this role requires driving company vehicles and trailers to remote job sites)
* Minimally qualified as an NWCG ENGB or CRWB, ICT5, and RXB3
* 5+ years of experience in forestry, fuels mitigation, vegetation management, or wildland fire operations in the public or private sector
* Demonstrated experience supervising fire crews or foremen
* Experience working with public agencies and regulatory bodies
* Strong working knowledge of prescribed fire operations, wildfire operations, and field safety standards
* Proven ability to manage reporting, documentation, and operational planning
* Physical ability to perform demanding field work (lifting up to 50 lbs, uneven terrain, long days outdoors)

  

Desired Qualifications

* Any of the following NWCG certifications: FIRB, RXB2/1, CRWB, ENGB, TFLD, DIVS, ICT4
* Experience in wildland firefighting and prescribed burning
* Experience operating farm, forestry, or other heavy equipment, trucks and large trailers
* Experience supporting proposal development and estimating
* Bachelor’s Degree in Forestry, Fire Science, Natural Resources, or related field
* NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist
* GIS Data Analysis

  

Still interested? Please apply at BurnBot.com/Careers or by sending your resume to careers@burnbot.com.

*

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Senior Manager, Product Operations, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive, design and develop innovative consumer products.
  
  
The person will lead a team responsible for defining and committing to the operations plan for delivery of innovative consumer products within Alexa Tablets Product Operations. In this role, you will operate at the earliest and most influential stage of the Product Development Process (PDP), the pre-concept phase, where you will combine the expertise of a business ownership, commodity expertise, product technical needs. You will be the operations authority that shapes product Roadmap for Alexa Tablet devices when decisions matter most, influencing critical choices before designs crystallize and features are locked. You must demonstrate leadership in a cross-functional, matrixed environment and able to succeed within an open, collaborative, peer environment.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Leading a team of high-impact professionals to define future products based on customer needs and viability

  

* Decomposing product concepts into component and manufacturing drivers using industry benchmarks and deep supply chain knowledge

  

* Influencing executive management on design decisions through dive deep into assumptions, communicating complex tradeoffs with clarity and confidence

  

* Facilitating decision-making conversations with Product Management, Engineering, and Supply Chain that balance product feature requirements, development timeline, and cost considerations

  

* Building and implementing methodology to enable high-fidelity analysis for product tradeoffs in early concept phase

  

* Providing guidance and support to both OPMs and MPMs to ensure cohesive supply chain strategies across Tablet Product Line

  

* Problem solve and explore solutions to current processes and systems

  

* Coordinate with cross functional teams throughout development and manufacturing

  

* Drive continuous improvements

  

* This role will require international travel

  
A day in the life  
As Sr. Manager, Tablet Product Ops, you will lead a small team of highly skilled operations professionals to define the next product concepts. You will spend significant time in collaborative sessions with product managers and engineers, framing complex tradeoffs between customer experience, technical performance, development timelines, and cost. You will proactively guide teams toward viable directions in the ambiguity of pre-concept development. Your afternoons might include assessing strategic recommendations, or diving deep into manufacturing requirements to assess feasibility of novel approaches.  
  
About the team  
Our Tablet Product Operations organization drives innovation in consumer electronics, bringing exciting products from concept to customer hands. The early-stage costing function sits at a critical juncture—where strategic decisions have maximum leverage but information is most uncertain. Our team values analytical rigor combined with practical judgment, collaborative problem-solving, and the courage to influence difficult decisions. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and supply chain professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences at sustainable costs.

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
* Comprehensive knowledge of consumer electronics supply chain from component sourcing through manufacturing and fulfillment

* Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
* Experience working directly with designers and technical subject matter experts
* Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 12+ years of experience in operations or commodity management roles
* Experience with multiple manufacturing processes (injection molding, die casting, PCB assembly, final assembly, etc.)

About Berkeley Mills

Berkeley Mills is a premier custom furniture and cabinetry manufacturer located in Berkeley, California. We specialize in designing and manufacturing exceptional kitchens, custom cabinetry, and fine furniture, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern design and manufacturing technology.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Kitchen Project Manager & Designer** to join our team. This position combines kitchen design, technical drafting, and project management, working closely with clients, architects, interior designers, engineers, and our in-house manufacturing team.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in kitchen and cabinetry design, proficiency in CAD software, and the ability to independently produce accurate design drawings. Experience preparing detailed cabinetry shop drawings is a significant advantage.

* Develop detailed kitchen layouts, floor plans, elevations, and design drawings using CAD software.

* Independently produce professional design drawings for client presentations, design approvals, and production coordination.
* Review and refine cabinetry layouts, dimensions, materials, finishes, and hardware specifications.

* Coordinate with our engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are practical, accurate, and ready for production.

* Ability to create detailed kitchen floor plans, elevations, and cabinetry layouts.

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Department Overview
  
  
Welcome to Electric Asset Strategy (EAS). We deliver risk-informed strategic plans that leverage inspection insights and asset data to guide maintenance and investment decisions.
  
  
The Distribution Asset Risk Management (ARM) team—comprising Asset Failure Analysis (AFA), Asset Insights, and Inspections & Maintenance Strategy (I&M)—focuses on continuously improving how PG&E monitors and maintains its assets to support a resilient, reliable grid and help keep our communities safe.

The Program Manager, Expert will lead the development, implementation, and financial stewardship of I&M strategy programs for PG&E’s electric distribution assets. The role will translate regulatory requirements, asset condition insights, risk analysis, budget planning, accounting considerations, and operational constraints into executable multiyear strategies and work plans that improve safety, reliability, compliance, affordability, and risk-spend efficiency.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Service Repair Quality
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is seeking a Program Manager to own North America Service repair quality. The focus of this work is changing from all customer comebacks to 3x comebacks: customers who return three or more times. This role makes that number one the field trusts, finds why those cars come back, and changes the process and the behavior that cause the return. You will not own the repair, the diagnosis engine, or the parts catalog. You will partner across Field, Training, Field Technical Support, Warranty, and Analytics so a failed repair becomes rarer, not just better documented.

The ideal candidate is credible with technicians, has the grit to stay on a stubborn comeback number, and the horsepower to separate a bad repair from a bad part, a bad process, or a bad handoff.

This role is based in Palo Alto, CA or Austin, TX, for proximity to Service Engineering, Training, and partner teams. It reports into Service Operations.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own Tesla Service repair-quality performance for North America, with the focus shifting to 3x comebacks, and run the plan that moves that metric
* In the first 30 days, learn the repair path end to end — from the correction on the visit through parts, the work itself, quality check, delivery, and the visit that comes back — in the tools and in a service center
* In the first 60 days, make the 3x comeback metric trustworthy: definition, source, owner, and what counts as a third return versus a single comeback, a new concern, a parts delay, or a customer choice
* Find the systemic drivers: standard work, handoff from diagnosis, parts, site process. Do not stop at “the technician missed it”
* Identify the technicians, sites, and habits that are actually movable, and drive adoption. A note in the bulletin is not a result
* Build one view with Business Analytics so the field, Training, and leadership are looking at the same repairs
* Partner with Field Technical Support, Training, Warranty, and Service Engineering without waiting for a perfect org chart; Report regularly to senior leadership on the number, what was tested, and what is next

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Track record of taking an untrusted quality or comeback metric and making it clean enough that the people who do the work will use it
* Has ramped on a repair, warranty, or field-service operation — tools and shop floor — in about 30 days. Sat with the people who do the job, not only read the process
* Changed technician or site behavior on quality, with a clear view of who, where, and what actually moved. Coached, did not police
* High EQ with technicians and managers. Can push a hard quality number without making the shop the enemy
* Sharp analytical horsepower: finds the real driver in noisy repair data. Comfortable with SQL or similar, and can size an opportunity on the spot
* 5+ years of program or operations management, ideally in automotive service, field service, warranty, or repair quality
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, including comfort presenting to senior leadership; Willingness to travel up to 25% to service centers

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$108,000 - $162,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. ### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Intellectual Property Law, Environmental Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of professional experience in the electronic consumer product scrap and recycling industry.
* 2 years of experience in asset disposition.
* 2 years of experience in a management or program leadership role.
* Experience in vendor performance management and contract administration.
* Experience developing and deploying security programs around confidential prototypes and unreleased products.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* R2, CSDS (Certified Secure Destruction Specialist) or CPP (Certified Protection Professional).
* Experience with "demanufacturing" processes—knowing exactly how to take apart a proprietary device to extract value without compromising secrets.
* Deep understanding of and experience in loss prevention/asset protection, conducting security risk assessments, physical security systems and processes, investigations, and corrective action planning (CAPA), writing and implementing security standards, along with basic understanding of EHS work flows and waste control regulations.
* Demonstrated high ethical standards with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately, with excellent judgment, discretion, and diplomacy.
* Ability to travel domestically or internationally.

**About the job**
-----------------

We are seeking a Global Destruction Program Manager to design, implement, and oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our most sensitive physical assets. This is not just a waste management role; it is a critical security function. You will be responsible for ensuring that prototypes, defective/decommissioned high-value components, proprietary pieces of hardware, devices, components and materials are rendered non-recoverable. You will lead a global network of certified vendors, ensuring that our intellectual property never leaks, ends up on the secondary market or in the hands of competitors.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $157000 - $227000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain global Secure Destruction SOPs aligned with security leadership, ensuring compliance with international trade, local laws, and data privacy regulations.
* Source, manage, and physically audit global destruction, smelting, and recycling partners via unannounced site visits to guarantee compliance.
* Classify critical Alphabet IP to define destruction standards, deploying RFID/GPS tracking to maintain end-to-end chain of custody through final certification.
* Conduct risk assessments, threat benchmarking, and lead investigations into asset leaks, theft, or grey-market breaches alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
* Leverage AI tools and program metrics to drive operational efficiency, scale secure workflows, and continuously modernize scrap destruction practices.

jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Opportunity:**

As a key member of the interdisciplinary clinic team, the Clinical Care Coordinator (CCC) plays an essential role in supporting members' daily experiences and sense of belonging at Amae Health. You'll help create a warm, engaging environment by facilitating group activities, wellness programming that encourage connection and growth. Working closely with our clinicians and staff, you'll share insights and contribute to a collaborative approach to member care. In addition to member engagement, you'll support clinic operations by managing communications, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with daily workflows. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented role, ideal for someone passionate about mental health, eager to learn, and excited to make a meaningful impact in their community.

**What You Will Work On:**

* **Member Engagement & Support -** Facilitate groups, arts and crafts, and recreational activities to enhance the member experience at Amae Health. Encourage positive social interactions and engagement in daily programming.
* **Clinic & Operational Support**- Welcome members to the clinic, manage communications via phone and email, and assist with scheduling and member record updates to support smooth daily operations.
* **Team Collaboration -** Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team—including psychiatrists, therapists, dietitians, and primary care providers—to share observations and support coordinated member care. Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions about member engagement.
* **Member Advocacy & Resource Connection** - Identify members' ongoing needs and help connect them with community resources and supports that promote wellness.
* **Growth & Development -** Contribute to projects that support clinic growth and ongoing member success. Participate in training and supervision to build skills in mental health support, community resources, and member engagement.

**About You:**

You're a people-person who enjoys creating meaningful connections and helping others feel supported. Organized and proactive, you bring positive energy to member activities and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You enjoy being part of a multidisciplinary team and contributing ideas that help members and teammates succeed. Curious and eager to learn, you welcome feedback and are motivated to grow your skills in mental health support and community resources. Most of all, you lead with empathy and keep members at the heart of everything you do. If you're excited to help shape a new clinic and make a lasting impact in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**What You'll have:**

* Enrolled or recently graduated in a degree program related to mental health, such as pre-med, psychology, social work, or nursing
* Interest in mental health and desire to work with members with Severe Mental Illness
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment
* Detail-oriented and organized

* Willingness to collaborate with others

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

**Program:** Compass's early childhood programs include 3 center-based programs tailored to meet the specific needs of children living in extreme poverty and homelessness. Together, the programs serve over 200 children ages 0-5 and their families each day. They address the social, emotional, cognitive, language, physical development, and special education needs of the children, as well as the functioning and well-being of the families. e community garden. These are all supported by our highly-qualified teaching staff and a wide variety of age-appropriate teaching tools.

**Organizational Core Competencies:** Accountable / Adaptable / Client-centered / Collaborative / Committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging / Resourceful

**Role Description:**  
The Special Education Care Coordinator ensures that children enrolled at Holy Family Day Home, Compass Children's Center, and Helen Hawk receive appropriate and timely special education and inclusion services. This role serves as the primary liaison between families and the San Francisco Unified School District (SFUSD), Golden Gate Regional Center (GGRC) and service providers. * Coordinate special education services for enrolled children to ensure timely access to appropriate supports.

* Maintain strong knowledge of special education laws, regulations, and legally mandated timelines to ensure compliance.
* Build and maintain relationships with local service providers to facilitate timely access to evaluations and services.
* Review ASQ screening data in Sparkler and collaborate with teaching staff and families to determine and initiate appropriate referrals.
* Partner with teaching staff to monitor progress and ensure continuity of care and services.

* Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.

jobs.title: People Operations & Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  
  
We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  
  
Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

As we scale, we need someone who can keep both our hiring engine and our employee experience running smoothly. This is a hybrid role: roughly half recruiting coordination and half People Operations. You will own interview logistics and the candidate experience on one side, and onboarding, benefits coordination, and core HR administration on the other.

You will be the connective tissue between candidates, new hires, and the teams they join. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and the People team, and you will keep finding ways to make our processes faster and better using AI tools. This is an ideal first or second step into a generalist People career for someone who wants real ownership and exposure to both talent and people operations at a fast-growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Recruiting Coordination (~50%)**

* Own interview scheduling and logistics across multiple concurrent searches, spanning technical and non-technical roles
* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, communicating with a warm, informative tone that makes every touchpoint feel considered
* Coordinate availability across candidates, interviewers, hiring managers, and leadership, including onsite and virtual interviews, panel prep, and debrief scheduling
* Proactively flag scheduling conflicts and pipeline bottlenecks before they become delays
* Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline hygiene in Ashby
* Support offer logistics and hand off new hires to People Ops

**People Operations (~50%)**

* Own end-to-end onboarding for new hires, including pre-employment background checks, new hire paperwork, I-9 verification, travel arrangements, and any other pre-boarding coordination
* Coordinate benefits administration, including new hire enrollment, answering employee benefits questions, and working with brokers and vendors
* Support core HR operations such as maintaining employee records and HRIS data accuracy
* Help prepare employment documentation, such as employment verifications, and status changes, etc in partnership with the People team
* Support employee lifecycle processes including role changes, leaves, and offboarding logistics
* Provide support and contribute to People programs and events such as team onsites, engagement efforts, and new hire welcomes

**Across Both Areas**

* Identify opportunities to use AI tools to streamline scheduling, communication, onboarding, and reporting, and help build and implement those improvements
* Suggest and drive improvements to our recruiting and People processes, especially in ambiguous or undefined situations
* Handle confidential candidate and employee information with care and good judgment

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Experience in Recruiting or People Ops:** 1 - 3 years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator, People Operations Coordinator, HR Coordinator, or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or tech company. Strong internship experience combined with exceptional ownership will also be considered
* **Organized and Detail-Oriented:** Manage many moving pieces, from interview loops to new hire checklists, without dropping details
* **Candidate and Employee-First Mentality:** Treat every interaction, whether with a candidate or a brand-new hire, as a chance to make someone feel supported
* **Strong Written and Verbal Communication:** Write clear, friendly emails that build rapport and keep every stakeholder informed
* **Trustworthy with Sensitive Information:** Understand the importance of confidentiality and use sound judgment when handling personal and employment data
* **AI-Native Working Style:** Use AI tools regularly to streamline your work, and you are excited to find new ways to apply them
* **Bias Towards Process Improvement:** Notice where a workflow is inefficient and take the initiative to fix it, rather than just working around it
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Work across two functions and many stakeholders at once, even when the process isn’t fully defined yet
* **Nice to have:** Experience with Ashby or a similar ATS, and Rippling or a similar HRIS and benefits platforms, and exposure to US employment basics (onboarding compliance, benefits enrollment cycles)

**What We Offer**
=================

* The base salary range for this role is $80,000-$100,000, depending on experience and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
* Flexible time off
* Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources
* Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well-being, and fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot
* Complimentary in-office

jobs.description:
QUALITY ASSURANCE MANAGER

Company: VahatiCor  
Status: Full-time, Exempt  
Location: Onsite, Santa Clara, CA  
Reports to: Chief Operations Officer • Manufacturing

ABOUT THE COMPANY

VahatiCor is a venture-backed medical technology company developing a new cardiovascular therapy. As the company grows beyond its startup incubator, it is building the quality systems and infrastructure needed to support its next stage.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a member of the Quality Department, the Quality Assurance Manager will oversee a team of inspectors and quality engineers. The Manager will support the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring processes are documented, updating top management on the effectiveness of the QMS and areas for improvement, and promoting quality policies throughout the organization.

The Manager will partner with R&D and Regulatory teams to ensure procedures are compliant and accurately documented for regulatory submissions.

This is a hands-on management role supporting VahatiCor's Class III catheter-based cardiovascular technologies, with particular emphasis on design controls, product development, risk management, manufacturing quality, design transfer, and regulatory inspection readiness.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Quality Management System (QMS)

* Support the QMS Management Representative by:
* + Ensuring processes needed for the quality management system are documented.
  + Reporting to top management on the effectiveness of the QMS and any need for improvement.
  + Ensuring the promotion and awareness of applicable regulatory and QMS requirements throughout the organization.
* Collaborate with departmental leaders to maintain quality procedures supporting VahatiCor's product development, manufacturing, and regulatory activities.
* Participate in management review activities and track identified quality system improvement actions.

Product Development, Design Controls, and Risk Management

* Partner with R&D to ensure efficient and compliant Quality System procedures for Product Development, Life Cycle Management, and Software Quality are established.
* Work with R&D teams to ensure product design projects are executed in accordance with regulatory requirements and VahatiCor's design control procedures.
* In partnership with R&D, ensure compliance with the most current ISO 14971 requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ensure all quality and regulatory-driven requirements for products and services in intended markets are mapped into product specifications and are traceable.
* Write and review protocols and reports, FMEAs, Design Verification and Validation documentation, Control Plans, Software Development strategies, plans and reports, and Process Validation protocols and reports.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs to ensure technical documentation supports applicable FDA submissions, clinical-stage development activities, and future commercialization requirements.

Manufacturing Quality, Supplier Quality, and Design Transfer

* Provide input into the development of inspection plans, quality agreements, and supplier agreements, with particular emphasis on Design Transfer.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing and Engineering to ensure approved design specifications, inspection requirements, manufacturing procedures, and quality acceptance criteria are appropriately transferred into production activities.
* Participate in quality reviews of contract manufacturers, suppliers, and associated manufacturing processes, including supplier audits and corrective actions as appropriate.
* Review manufacturing and process validation documentation for consistency with quality system procedures and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Patient Services Representative
jobs.description:
Supporting Community Healthcare is a rewarding role, come join a wonderful organization! LifeLong Medical Care is looking for a **Patient Services Representative** (PSR) to join our Call Center team in Berkeley. The PSR serve as front-line phone staff and “navigators” for our patients, their caregivers and other healthcare entities in our busy Patient Services Call Center. Answer incoming calls, register patients and schedule appointments, triage calls to different departments including urgent calls, document and task messages and other notes in patients’ Electronic Health Record (EHR). Perform other Patient Services Department duties as needed.

This is a full time, 40 hours/week, benefit eligible position. Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

*LifeLong Medical Care is a multi-site, Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) with a rich history of providing innovative healthcare and social services to a wonderfully diverse patient community. Our patient-centered health home is a dynamic place to work, practice, and grow. We have over 15 primary care health centers and deliver integrated services including psychosocial, referrals, chronic disease management, dental, health education, home visits, and much, much more.*

*Benefits*

*Compensation: $22/hour. We offer excellent benefits including: medical, dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous leave benefits including ten paid holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) retirement savings plan.*

*Responsibilities*

* Follows all departmental and organizational policies and procedures, establishes and maintains courteous, cooperative relations with the public, patients, and staff from all departments.
* Ensures and promotes excellent customer service to all internal and external customers.
* Answers incoming calls and responds to all callers’ inquiries; monitors call center queues to ensure calls are answered in a timely manner and executed correctly.
* Utilizes NextGen Electronic Practice Management (EMP) and Electronic Health Record (EHR) for all patient interactions.
* Schedules/reschedules appointments for patients.
* Triages calls based on established procedures including urgent medical calls. Pages health center staff as needed.
* Screens new patients over the phone for eligibility and registers as appropriate.
* Maintains established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for call volume, call duration and call quality in a fast-paced, busy call center that receives over 26,000 calls per month.
* Verifies current demographics and insurance information with every patient, enrolls patients in LifeLong Patient Portal, and updates information in system as necessary.
* Maintains effective written and verbal communication including appropriate and clear communication in patients’ Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Electronic Practice Management System (EPM).
* Answers non-patient incoming calls and requests for information, and transfers to the appropriate department(s).
* Answers questions and provides general information, refers to appropriate resources.
* Assists with training and onboarding of new Patient Services Representatives.
* Performs other related duties as required.

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills and ability to effectively work with people from diverse backgrounds and be culturally sensitive. Ability to show empathy to patients with complex health needs.
* Excellent customer service skills using a positive, proactive, “can-do” approach.
* Ability to work effectively and calmly under pressure in a positive, friendly manner.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple tasks.
* Strong problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change.
* Ability to work in a team-oriented environment with staff with different work and communication styles.

***Job Requirements***

* One (1) year of multi-line telephone experience and/or one (1) year experience as medical receptionist with scheduling and telephone experience.
* High school diploma/GED.
* Demonstrated computer skills with standard office software (MS Office) and typing speed of at least 30 WPM.
* Ability to read and comprehend instructions, procedures, emails and memos.
* Ability to abide by LifeLong’s Organizational Standards for conduct and attendance.
* Knowledge of basic medical terminology.
* Ability to effectively present information verbally and in written communications to patients and staff.

***Job Preferences***

* At least one-year of experience in a healthcare setting preferred including experience in private practice, or a Community Health Center.
* Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

Hardware

monitor supply chain performance, identify trends, and support strategic decisions.

statistical models and ERP/MRP systems to optimize inventory levels and reduce

stockouts or excess.

inventory management; recommend and implement process improvements.

* Supplier Communication: Ability to communicate effectively at working level and

independently with supplier executives.

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

* Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

* Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research.

* Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world.

* Enjoy job stability with startup vitality.

* Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs.

  

**Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!**

*Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.
