**Our Team's Vision:**

The People Team exists to unlock the potential of every Illumineer and build the talent, leadership, and culture that powers Illumio's success. Guided by our "People First. Mission Always." philosophy, we combine human connection, operational excellence, and AI-enabled innovation to create a workplace where exceptional people can do the best work of their careers while serving our customers and helping the company grow, scale, and lead.

* Manage and improve employee lifecycle processes, from onboarding, job changes, promotions, transfers, leaves, to offboarding.

jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
San Francisco Bay Area • New York City Area • Dallas-Fort Worth Area

Info Security

In office

Full-time

**About Groq**

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. We pioneered the LPU—the first processor designed specifically for AI inference—and are transforming that innovation into a global cloud platform powering production AI workloads.

  

With the capital, infrastructure, and team to execute, we're uniquely positioned to define the next era of AI infrastructure. The opportunity is massive, and it's still wide open. Now let's go build it!

**Mission**

Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. You will keep the control set mapped once so a single test produces evidence for every framework, maintain the GRC tool as the system of record, own Groq's IT policies and security training, and take on audit execution to mature the GRC function from reactive to proactive program.

  

**Location:** This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the **Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area**. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

  

**Responsibilities & opportunities in this role:**

* Run the audit calendar across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and other frameworks; manage day-to-day auditor relationships, fieldwork logistics and evidence readiness.
* Track audit findings through to closure with owners and dates so findings do not recur between cycles.
* Maintain the control catalogue and framework mapping so one control test produces evidence for every framework it satisfies, and coordinate SME evidence requests so each control is evidenced once per period, not once per framework.
* Maintain Vanta GRC as the system of record: integration coverage, automated evidence, test ownership and documentation within their review cycle.
* Own the IT policy lifecycle (review cadence, approvals, acknowledgements) and the security awareness training program, with completion tracked as audit evidence; report audit status, open findings and evidence coverage to security leadership on a recurring basis.
  

  

**Ideal candidates have/are:**

* 5+ years in compliance program management, including hands-on execution of at least two concurrent framework audits.
* Experience mapping controls across frameworks and reducing duplicate evidence collection, and administering a GRC platform as a system of record.
* Experience managing external auditors, drafting scope statements for executive review, and coordinating SMEs across stakeholders.
* Experience owning a policy lifecycle and a security awareness training program, with completion evidence that has stood up in audit.
* Experience at a Big 4 or equivalent audit firm delivering compliance engagements, so you know how auditors scope, sample and write findings.
* Legal background preferred
  

  

**Why Join Us:**

* **Purposeful Hiring**: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build with matters.
* **Builders Wanted**: You’re not just riding the rocket ship, you’re building it. Your work directly shapes the trajectory of our company.
* **Mission-Driven Work**: We’re here to make a real impact. Our mission fuels everything we do.
* **Tackling Hard Problems**: If easy isn’t your thing, you’re in the right place. We solve some of the most complex and exciting challenges in our space.
* **Excellence Is The Standard**: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious.
  

  

**Compensation**

Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary range for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is $186,600 - $252,400, with individual placement determined by your geographic location, experience, skills, and alignment with internal compensation standards. This range is specific to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for international candidates will vary based on local market dynamics. Beyond cash compensation, Groq also offers a Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program and a robust suite of employee benefits.

jobs.title: Materials Program Manager - (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.

Overview:

In this role, you’ll own the creation and oversight of left-to-right clear to build schedules to support builds. As an MPM, you will oversee manufacturing operations (production, quality, material planning), cost, schedule, and deliverables during New Product Introduction (NPI), Ramp and Sustaining Phases as well as organize and oversee manufacturing (in-house or Contract Manufacturer) transition from validation to ramp and production states.

This is a temporary position for 4-6 months, based in Marina, CA.

Responsibilities:

* Create and deploy supply requirements to the supply base via MRP which achieves production, inventory and cost objectives. Ensure demand from all sources (production, aftermarket, engineering, etc.) is supported appropriately
* Manage safety stock levels and optimize logistical efficiency by managing EOQs
* Manage planning system parameters and master data to optimally reflect supply chain capabilities and plan supply. Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage, run-out reports, and other analyses as needed to plan production and business targets. Provide data-driven decision support to the broader organization through what-if and scenario planning (as examples)
* Work with external suppliers to establish the appropriate delivery schedules for individual components, specifying quantity and frequency, targeting on-time delivery; coordinate with the Supply Chain team and Logistics as needed
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Engineering to support material changes resulting from Change action (CAs), plan for new material, and minimize obsolescence of old material
* Apply analytics and supply chain expertise to manage system parameters and meet target inventory and service level goals while minimizing costs and obsolescence
* Build and maintain operational partnerships with assigned suppliers. Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues, and resolution
* Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (procurement, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.)
* Support onboarding and training of new suppliers to ensure operational excellence and compliance with Joby’s supply chain processes and policies
* Coordinate supplier ramp-up and down for new product launches, ensuring suppliers deliver shipments needed to support production targets
* Manage engineering changes to minimize obsolete inventory and ensure continuous supply

Required:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or other related field, or equivalent experience
* 1+ years related experience in materials management, production planning, material scheduling, or purchasing in a manufacturing environment
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including the ability to maintain and enhance Excel-based material shortage reports
* Strong analytical capabilities

Desired:

* Knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software, SAP enterprise system inventory management system such as SAP to Microsoft

Additional Information:

This is a temporary role, anticipated to last 4-6 months. The target base pay for this position is $40 - $60 per hour.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Tavus customers are building products and experiences with conversational AI. Getting from a signed contract to a successful deployment takes more than access to the platform. Customers need clear priorities, a workable implementation plan, and a partner who understands what they are trying to accomplish.

You will report to our Customer Lead and take ownership of an existing portfolio of customers, helping them move through implementation, adoption, and renewal. You will run the day-to-day relationship, coordinate technical partners, and keep customer commitments moving.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful independence. Your portfolio will include ongoing implementations and established customers between renewal cycles. You will inherit unfinished work, build trust with customers, and establish a clear plan for what happens next.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own your portfolio.** Build relationships with the people using, implementing, and buying Tavus. Understand their business objectives, success criteria, decision process, and reasons to renew.
* **Turn customer goals into working plans.** Establish milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision dates. For new customers, work with Sales and Customer Engineering to carry the buying context and agreed scope into onboarding. For existing customers, reconstruct missing context and reset the plan where needed.
* **Run dependable customer communication.** Acknowledge requests, clarify their impact, secure the right internal owner, and set the next update. Keep customers informed when answers or delivery dates change, without requiring them to chase.
* **Drive adoption and customer value.** Identify stalled implementations, weak engagement, and unrealized use cases. Determine whether the constraint is product quality, implementation, customer capacity, sponsorship, or fit, and coordinate a practical intervention.
* **Prioritize across accounts.** Allocate attention using customer impact, revenue, growth potential, urgency, and implementation complexity. Make tradeoffs explicit when competing requests exceed available capacity.
* **Coordinate technical work.** Give Customer Engineering, Support, Product, and Engineering useful context: what the customer is experiencing, what they have tried, what is blocked, and why it matters. Track the work through a verified answer or agreed next step.
* **Run renewal preparation and execution for assigned accounts.** Understand renewal intent early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, develop a recommendation, and coordinate the process through a decision. Partner with the Customer Lead and Sales on negotiation and commercial approvals.
* **Identify credible expansion opportunities.** Connect additional use cases to a buyer, a business outcome, and a feasible deployment path. Bring qualified opportunities to the appropriate commercial owner.
* **Maintain an actionable account record.** Keep the business objective, implementation status, usage, sponsor, risks, commitments, and next decision current. Distinguish progress from completion and customer interest from an agreed commitment.
* **Improve how we operate.** Turn recurring questions and successful interventions into reusable guidance, onboarding practices, and adoption and renewal playbooks. Surface product and documentation gaps with evidence of their customer impact.

**How ownership works**
-----------------------

You own the relationship, account plan, customer communication, and commercial readiness of your assigned portfolio. You are responsible for keeping work moving across teams and making unresolved decisions visible.

Customer Engineering owns technical implementation and troubleshooting. Product and Engineering own platform fixes and technical readiness. You work closely with those teams to establish owners, communicate confirmed capabilities and limitations, and agree on the next customer checkpoint.

When a request lacks an owner, a credible delivery plan, or an agreed scope, you escalate with the customer impact, options, and decision needed. You are comfortable setting expectations and explaining tradeoffs without promising work another team has not committed to deliver.

You will run routine account decisions independently within agreed priorities and commercial guidelines. Strategic escalations, pricing exceptions, and commitments beyond existing scope are handled with the Customer Lead and the relevant functional owner.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Experience independently managing a portfolio of B2B customers through implementation, adoption, and renewal.
* Experience with APIs, AI, infrastructure, developer tools, or another technical product where customer implementation materially affects success.
* The ability to enter an account with incomplete information, ask focused questions, and establish a coherent plan.
* Commercial judgment: you can connect product performance, usage, customer economics, sponsorship, and business value to retention and expansion.
* Strong follow-through across several accounts and internal teams. You keep commitments visible and recognize when a stalled next step requires a decision.
* Clear writing and sound judgment in difficult customer conversations. You communicate uncertainty honestly, bring bad news early, and adapt the detail to your audience.
* Enough technical fluency to understand an integration, gather useful evidence, and work credibly with engineers. Production software development is not a requirement.
* Evidence that you can prioritize competing demands, challenge an ineffective proposed solution, and set realistic expectations while maintaining trust.
* Comfort improving processes while using them. You can establish useful structure without waiting for a finished playbook.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.  
  
Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.  
  
We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.  
  
**Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.**

**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

We’re looking for a high-ownership, execution-driven Senior Product Manager to build the next generation of clinical and care delivery systems at Abby Care. You’ll own the product experience for RN case managers, caregivers, and clinical operations teams who deliver care to our families.This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and regulated environments, calculates trade-offs, moves with urgency, and drives momentum across engineering, clinical, and operations teams. You’ll partner closely with our clinical leadership to build products that improve care quality, clinical outcomes, and operational efficiency.  
  
You’ll own complex, clinically critical product areas end-to-end including personalized care planning, clinical assessment automation, proactive care adjustments, care team coordination, quality assurance, and clinical decision support.  
  
*(Please note: While you will be driving these clinical initiatives, prior clinical AI product experience is a plus, not a strict requirement. We are looking for strong product fundamentals and a desire to dive deep into clinical workflows.)*

* **Translate Real-World Clinical Workflows:** Partner deeply with clinicians, caregivers, and compliance teams to understand how care is delivered today, transforming those clinical workflows into intuitive, reliable, and scalable product experiences.
* **Innovate Alongside the Care Ecosystem:** Collaborate with providers, payors, regulators, and internal clinical leaders to unlock new models of care delivery. Focus heavily on developing systems where AI models evaluate care delivery against established clinical protocols.
* **Raise the Bar for Product Thinking:** Act as a senior leader in setting a high standard for product clarity, judgment, and craft. Mentor peers, inspire cross-functional collaboration, and continuously elevate how product decisions are made and shipped across EPD.

**What you'll have:**
---------------------

jobs.title: Learning & Development Lead, Operations
jobs.description:
**Learning & Development Lead — Operations**

**Role Overview**

The Learning & Development Lead owns training and readiness for Physical Intelligence's robot operator workforce.

This person is responsible for designing and running the systems that take a new operator from candidate work trial through their first 30–60 days, with the goal of getting people productive quickly while maintaining a high quality bar.

They also own ongoing training as the work changes. When researchers introduce new robot workflows, tasks, tools, or operating procedures, the Learning & Development Lead translates those changes into training that can be rolled out quickly and consistently across the operation.

This is a highly operational training role. We are looking for someone who has built or owned training programs for hourly or frontline employees and knows how to turn complex work into a simple, repeatable learning process.

**Responsibilities**

**Operator Trials & Readiness**

* Own the operator work-trial program and ensure candidates are evaluated consistently.
* Maintain clear trial standards, evaluator guidance, and scoring criteria.
* Partner with recruiting and operations to continuously improve what the trial predicts about future operator success.

**New-Hire Onboarding**

* Build and run onboarding from day one through the first 30–60 days.
* Define what an operator should know and be able to do at each stage of ramp.
* Create training plans, checklists, certification steps, and readiness milestones.
* Identify struggling operators early and create clear paths for remediation.
* Continuously improve time-to-productivity for new hires.

**New Workflow Training**

* Partner with researchers and operations teams when new robot tasks, systems, or processes are introduced.
* Learn new workflows quickly and translate them into clear training materials and operating instructions.
* Design the rollout plan needed to train a large operator population quickly.
* Track who has been trained and verify that the training actually resulted in correct execution.
* Maintain consistency as training expands across shifts, teams, and locations.

**Training Operations**

* Maintain a clear training calendar and ensure training happens when required.
* Coordinate trainers, operators, shift leads, and researchers.
* Keep training materials current as workflows change.
* Build repeatable processes so training does not depend on tribal knowledge.
* Track training completion, readiness, and performance metrics.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Use operator performance data and feedback to identify gaps in training.
* Work with operations leaders to understand recurring quality or productivity issues.
* Determine whether problems are caused by training, instructions, process, tooling, or something else.
* Continuously simplify and improve how operators learn.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience owning training, onboarding, or workforce development programs for hourly or frontline employees.
* Demonstrated ability to get new employees productive quickly.
* Experience building structured ramp programs with clear milestones and standards.
* Strong operational organization and follow-through.
* Able to turn ambiguous or technical workflows into simple, teachable processes.
* Comfortable managing trainers, who are responsible for training large groups of people on new procedures under tight timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Able to work effectively with both highly technical stakeholders, trainers, and frontline operators.
* Comfortable in an environment where processes and requirements change frequently.
* Uses data and observation to improve training rather than relying only on subjective feedback.

Experience in robotics is not required.

*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Legacy Executive Club is a peer advisory community for senior executives and founders. * **Location:** Fully remote

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations (CRAs)

* Conduct regular meetings and maintain one-on-one communications.

* Assist with the development of strategies in assigned areas, as needed.

* Excellent organizational, communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and prioritize to proactively address any challenges in order to meet deadlines.
* Strong problem solving, deductive reasoning and decision-making skills.
* Ability to travel <10%.

jobs.title: IT Operations Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:

We know you have choices, so our team of collaborative, innovative professionals are ready to support your professional development. At Citrin Cooperman, we offer competitive compensation and benefits and most importantly, the flexibility to manage your personal and professional life to focus on what matters most to you!

We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Operations Manager who also acts as the Delivery Manager for infrastructure projects. You will run the infrastructure intake process, track critical projects through to delivery, and provide timely, accurate metrics and status reporting to stakeholders. You will work closely with operations, engineering, vendors, and business teams so that infrastructure initiatives (migrations, upgrades, data center moves, new site rollouts) are well governed, visible, and delivered on schedule.

**Responsibilities are, but not limited to:**

* Design, document, and continuously refine the Infrastructure Projects Intake process, including request channels, intake forms and templates, triage and prioritization criteria, approval gates, SLAs, roles and responsibilities, and workflows (e.g., in ServiceNow, Jira, or Azure DevOps).
* Own and run the Infrastructure Intake process day to day, from request submission through triage, assessment, prioritization, and approval, working with architects, engineers, and security to validate scope, effort, dependencies, and risk.
* Maintain the intake queue and backlog, communicate decisions and timelines to requestors, and convert approved requests into projects with clear scope, owners, and milestones.
* Manage delivery of infrastructure projects from initiation through planning, execution, cutover, hypercare, and handover to operations, including cloud migrations, data center moves, server and storage refreshes, network and SD-WAN upgrades, DR implementation, and new site rollouts.
* Build and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and resource plans; apply the right methodology (Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid); run stage gates and project reviews; and manage scope changes through formal change control.
* Lead go-live readiness reviews and cutover planning, including operational acceptance criteria, test and rollback plans, change windows, and hypercare, so that new infrastructure is fully supportable before handover.
* Track all critical projects in a consolidated view, monitoring milestones, dependencies, and risks, and escalate slippage early with clear impact analysis and recommended actions.
* Maintain the infrastructure project portfolio and roadmap, forecast resource and capacity demand across teams and vendors, and align priorities with business needs, architecture standards, and the technology strategy.
* Define, collect, and publish delivery and operations metrics (project health, intake cycle times and backlog, on-time and on-budget rates, availability, MTTR, change success rate, patch compliance, vendor SLA performance) through dashboards and scorecards in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or ServiceNow.
* Produce timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly status reports with RAG status, risks, issues, decisions needed, and upcoming milestones, plus executive summaries for steering committees and leadership reviews.
* Maintain stakeholder communication plans, RACI, and escalation paths, and coordinate business notifications and downtime approvals for planned changes and cutovers.
* Coordinate with operations teams so projects transition smoothly into support with runbooks, monitoring, and knowledge articles in place; participate in the Change Advisory Board (CAB); and follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, and configuration processes, including CMDB accuracy.
* Track major incidents and problem records that affect projects or service levels, and follow root cause analysis (RCA) corrective actions through to closure.
* Coordinate with vendors, MSPs, cloud providers, and carriers on deliverables and timelines, and track and report on vendor performance against contracts and SLAs.

LAZ Parking is one of the largest operators in the growing multi-billion-dollar US parking industry. Founded in 1981, LAZ operates hundreds of thousands of parking spaces from offices nationwide. When it comes to parking, we are the experts!

The Project Management Office (PMO) supports projects across every department at LAZ, including Operations, Finance, Technology, HR, Client Services, and newly acquired or partner businesses. The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams, coordinates internal and external partners, and keeps projects moving toward organizational goals.

The PMO works as both a project lead and a consulting partner. Depending on the project, this role may run a project end to end or help a department plan and run their own work using PMO tools and resources. jobs.description:
**Data Analytics Program Manager**

**Role Overview**

A large e-commerce and logistics client is looking for a data-first program operator to own the analytics backbone of a fast-scaling energy and power planning function. This person manages large, complex datasets across hundreds to thousands of active sites in various stages of planning, due diligence, capital approval, and construction - translating raw data into decisions and building the tracking infrastructure the team runs on.

This is not a traditional program manager role. The core skillset is data - querying it, modeling it, centralizing it, and making it actionable. Strong operational discipline ensures that analytical outputs actually drive cross-functional alignment, risk visibility, and on-time delivery across PMO, Finance, Capital Management, Pre-Construction, and Construction stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

Own and maintain centralized trackers spanning the full site lifecycle - from demand forecasting and site selection through power due diligence, capital approval, utility engagement, and construction delivery

* - across a portfolio of hundreds to thousands of locations simultaneously
* Build and manage data models that integrate inputs from multiple internal and third-party sources into a single, reliable source of truth for portfolio health, risk, cost, and timeline status
* Design and stand up risk tracking frameworks that embed site-level due diligence outputs directly into downstream PMO and capital workflows, closing handoff gaps between site selection and delivery teams
* Produce executive-level reporting and dashboards that surface portfolio risk, cost variance, milestone status, and coverage gaps in real time
Identify data gaps, ownership ambiguities, and process breakdowns across stakeholder groups and build the mechanisms to fix them* - trackers, playbooks, operating rhythms, and escalation frameworks
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure utility infrastructure and interconnect costs flow accurately into capital approval budgets
* Drive automation opportunities across high-frequency data workflows and define requirements for tooling improvements

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years in a data analyst or data-heavy program management role managing large, multi-variable datasets across complex portfolios
PMP certification or equivalent* - used to structure ambiguity, not just manage schedules
* Advanced Excel/Sheets and hands-on BI tool experience (Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight, or similar)
* SQL proficiency; Python a strong plus
* Proven ability to build centralized tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch across multiple stakeholder groups
Experience in capital-intensive industries* - energy, utilities, infrastructure, real estate, or logistics strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work backward from a messy data landscape and build clean, scalable systems that others depend on

jobs.title: Care Coordinator Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**Must be able to work in Eastern standard time zone or Central.**

The Care Coordination Specialist works under RN supervision to provide coordinated care services for injured workers with low to moderate complexity claims. This position ensures continuity of medical services and facilitates communication between all parties involved while supporting return-to-work efforts within workers' compensation guidelines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Communicate work status updates to injured workers, employers, and claims adjusters

* Follow established care plans and treatment protocols under RN supervision
* Monitor injured worker adherence to treatment plans and compare progress to established guidelines
* Maintain accurate documentation of medical history and case progress in WC system using approved formats
* Facilitate return-to-work efforts through coordination with employers and providers
* Escalate cases to RN supervision when clinical complexity increases beyond the scope

**Administrative Functions**

* Maintain and update case review notes and documentation on all assigned cases
* Complete time management tracking on all cases
* Attend team meetings and training sessions as scheduled
* Ensure cost containment through the utilization of in-network providers when appropriate
* Support network provider coordination efforts

**COMPETENCIES**

* Professional communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
* Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek supervision
* Understanding of confidentiality requirements and HIPAA guidelines
* Basic analytical skills for routine case assessment
* Adaptability in a fast-paced work environment

Qualifications:

**Education & Licensure:**

  

* High School Diploma required

**Experience:**

* 2+ years of clinical experience required
* Workers' compensation or disability management experience is highly preferred

**Skills:**

* Demonstrated organizational, technological, and communication skills
* Basic understanding of disability management principles
* Computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel), keyboard skills, and data entry capabilities

**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:**

* Manage assigned caseload of low to moderate complexity workers' compensation claims
* Achieve established metrics for routine case resolution and return-to-work outcomes
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation per department standards
* Escalate cases appropriately when clinical complexity exceeds the scope of practice
* Demonstrate professional growth through continuing education and training participation
* Support team objectives and departmental goals

Works under the direct supervision of the RN Case Manager or the WC Nurse Supervisor. Receives guidance on complex cases and clinical decision-making. Expected to work independently on routine coordination tasks while maintaining regular communication with the supervising RN.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
**Speedy Sticks** is a nationwide mobile phlebotomy company providing convenient, reliable blood collection services to patients in their homes and other designated locations. We work with healthcare providers, laboratories, research organizations, and other healthcare-related businesses to coordinate mobile specimen collection services throughout the United States.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Quality Assurance Specialist** to help maintain the accuracy, completeness, and quality of our mobile phlebotomy operations.

***Job Summary***

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for reviewing phlebotomists’ submitted appointment forms, service documentation, and other operational records to ensure that all required information is accurate, complete, and submitted according to company procedures.

This individual will identify errors, missing information, inconsistencies, and potential compliance issues, communicate with phlebotomists and internal team members to resolve deficiencies, and help improve the overall quality and efficiency of our services.

The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to identify problems before they affect patients, clients, or business operations.

***Key Responsibilities1. Submission Form Review & Quality Control***

* Review mobile phlebotomy submission forms for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company requirements.
* Verify that required fields, patient and appointment information, collection details, timestamps, and other applicable documentation are completed correctly.
* Identify missing information, incorrect entries, inconsistencies, illegible documentation, and incomplete submissions.
* Verify that required supporting documents, signatures, requisitions, and other applicable records are included when necessary.
* Flag incomplete or incorrect submissions and follow up with phlebotomists to obtain corrections.
* Track outstanding submissions and ensure deficiencies are resolved in a timely manner.
* Confirm that corrected forms meet company standards before marking them as complete.

***2. Phlebotomist Performance & Documentation Monitoring***

* Monitor the quality and consistency of documentation submitted by mobile phlebotomists.
* Identify recurring mistakes, documentation deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain records of submission errors and quality-related issues.
* Provide constructive feedback and communicate documentation requirements to phlebotomists.
* Escalate repeated errors, unresolved issues, or significant quality concerns to management.

***3. Compliance & Standard Operating Procedures***

* Ensure documentation follows Speedy Sticks' established procedures and applicable client requirements.
* Help maintain adherence to applicable privacy, confidentiality, specimen-handling documentation, and recordkeeping requirements.
* Identify potential compliance risks and escalate concerns to the appropriate manager.
* Help ensure that required documentation is handled securely and only accessed by authorized personnel.
* Support the consistent implementation of company quality standards and procedures.

***4. Specimen Collection & Service Quality***

* Review applicable collection records to identify documentation discrepancies or missing collection-related information.
* Verify that required specimen collection, handling, packaging, and shipping documentation is completed when applicable.
* Identify and report documented issues involving specimen labeling, specimen integrity, processing, packaging, or transportation.
* Help investigate service complaints, collection-related incidents, and documentation errors.
* Escalate potential specimen integrity or patient safety concerns promptly to management.

***5. Quality Reporting & Recordkeeping***

* Maintain organized records of reviewed submissions, identified errors, corrections, and unresolved issues.
* Prepare regular quality assurance reports summarizing submission accuracy, error trends, recurring deficiencies, and outstanding corrections.
* Track quality metrics, including submission completeness, error rates, correction turnaround times, and recurring issues.
* Maintain quality tracking spreadsheets, internal systems, and other company reporting tools.
* Assist management in identifying areas where additional training, process improvements, or corrective action may be necessary.

***6. Process Improvement & Team Support***

* Recommend improvements to submission forms, documentation workflows, and quality control procedures.
* Help develop and update quality assurance checklists, internal guidelines, and standard operating procedures.
* Assist with training and educating phlebotomists on proper documentation and submission requirements.
* Collaborate with scheduling, operations, management, and other departments to resolve quality-related issues.
* Perform additional quality assurance and operational support duties as assigned.

***Qualifications***

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to review large volumes of documentation while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
* Proficiency with computers, spreadsheets, online forms, and administrative software.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow established procedures.
* Ability to handle confidential patient information responsibly.
* Healthcare administration, medical records, laboratory, phlebotomy, or quality assurance experience is preferred but not required, depending on the candidate's qualifications.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Previous experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, medical documentation, or administrative auditing.
* Familiarity with mobile phlebotomy workflows and laboratory requisitions.
* Understanding of HIPAA priva

jobs.description:
Medical Editor – Arbitration & IDR Quality Assurance Specialist

**Elite Billing & Collections | Remote Position**

About the Position

Elite Billing & Collections is seeking an experienced, highly detail-oriented **Medical Editor** to join our growing Arbitration and Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) team.

This position is responsible for reviewing, editing, and strengthening arbitration submissions prepared by our paralegal team. The Medical Editor will serve as a critical quality assurance checkpoint, ensuring that every submission presents a clear, persuasive, medically accurate, and well-supported argument.

We are looking for someone who understands medical documentation, can identify weaknesses in written arguments, and has the ability to elevate the overall quality and effectiveness of our arbitration submissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and edit completed arbitration and IDR submissions prepared by paralegals.
* Evaluate the strength, clarity, accuracy, and persuasiveness of medical and reimbursement arguments.
* Strengthen medical narratives by highlighting procedural complexity, patient acuity, medical necessity, provider expertise, and other relevant clinical factors supported by the documentation.
* Review operative reports, clinical records, and supporting exhibits to ensure arguments accurately reflect the medical services performed.
* Identify weak arguments, missing information, inconsistencies, and opportunities to strengthen submissions.
* Ensure all claims and supporting statements are factually accurate and substantiated by medical records or other appropriate evidence.
* Verify medical terminology, procedural descriptions, diagnoses, and CPT codes for accuracy and consistency.
* Ensure submissions are professionally written, properly structured, and free of grammatical or formatting errors.
* Provide constructive feedback to paralegals to improve the overall quality of future submissions.
* Collaborate with paralegals and management to resolve documentation discrepancies and address quality concerns.
* Maintain high productivity and quality standards while reviewing a substantial volume of arbitration cases.
* Ensure submissions meet internal quality standards and applicable arbitration or IDR requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Professional experience in medical editing, medical writing, clinical documentation, medical billing, or a related healthcare field.
* Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, surgical procedures, and clinical documentation.
* Exceptional editing, proofreading, and professional writing skills.
* Ability to critically evaluate written arguments and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience interpreting operative reports and medical records.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or unsupported statements.
* Excellent time management skills and ability to meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with medical arbitration, Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR), or the No Surprises Act (NSA).
* Experience reviewing medical necessity arguments, reimbursement appeals, or insurance disputes.
* Background in orthopedic surgery, spine surgery, pain management, or other surgical specialties.
* CPC, CCS, RN, or other relevant healthcare credentials.
* Experience in quality assurance, medical documentation auditing, or medical-legal editing.

What We're Looking For

**This is not simply a proofreading position.**

We need someone who can critically assess the quality of an arbitration submission, recognize where the medical or reimbursement arguments are weak, and make meaningful improvements that strengthen the case.

The ideal candidate will have exceptional analytical skills, strong medical knowledge, and the ability to ensure every submission is accurate, professional, persuasive, and supported by appropriate documentation.

Our goal is to produce consistently high-quality arbitration submissions that effectively communicate the medical complexity and relevant circumstances of each case.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in medical editing, clinical documentation review, medical writing, or healthcare reimbursement.

Candidates with experience reviewing complex medical records and strengthening medical or reimbursement arguments are strongly encouraged to apply.

Position is fully remote. Benefits not included except Paid Time Off.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.

We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.

We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.

**The opportunity**
===================

More than one billion notarizations take place in the United States each year, supporting consequential transactions across real estate, financial services, legal services, automotive, wealth management, and other regulated industries. Snapdocs provides trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions—transactions where the parties may not know or trust one another, mistakes carry real consequences, and the resulting records must withstand legal, regulatory, investor, and customer scrutiny. We earned our credibility by modernizing residential mortgage closings at scale, and became the market leader. Now, we’re taking on the broader notarization market, with a vision to make Snapdocs the trusted platform for every high-stakes notarization—across industries, wherever and however it happens.

Customer Success is central to realizing this opportunity. This role will help customers redesign operational workflows, adopt new in-person and remote notarization capabilities, and demonstrate measurable business value. The Customer Success Manager will also translate customer needs and early market learnings into product, operational, and go-to-market decisions as Snapdocs expands into new industries and use cases.

Quantify realized value and build the business case for continued and broader adoption.

Design and execute plays that close adoption and utilization gaps, introduce new capabilities, and increase customer value.
* **Provide product and workflow guidance.** Demonstrate Notary Connect and Snapdocs RON, answer customer questions, recommend workflow best practices, and bring in the appropriate internal expert when deeper product, technical, operational, legal, or compliance expertise is required.
* **Own renewals and expansion.** Lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through close. Build the value case, develop the commercial offer, negotiate terms and tradeoffs within approved guardrails, align the customer’s buying group, and maintain accurate forecasts. * **Turn customer insight into organizational advantage.** Synthesize recurring customer feedback, market patterns, and competitive signals into actionable input for Product, Operations, and go-to-market teams. Dompé is an Italian bio-pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovation, where a long tradition in the field of personal wellness goes hand-in-hand with a commitment to research and development to meet unsatisfied therapeutic needs.

  

Established in 1940 in Milan, Dompé has an industrial and biotech research hub in L’Aquila, in addition to branches in Europe (Barcelona, Berlin, Paris and Tirana). The company has approximately 900 employees. The US headquarters of Dompé are based in Boston (R&D) and in the San Francisco Bay Area (Commercial Operations).

**YOUR ROLE AT DOMPÉ**

The Patient Access Manager reports to the Associate Director, Patient Access Manager and will be a key member of the US organization supporting the company’s efforts related to cenegermin eye drops, which are based on rhNGF (recombinant human nerve growth factor).

Approved in August 2018, OxervateTM eye drops (cenegermin-bkbj ophthalmic solution) is the first-ever topical biologic medication approved in ophthalmology and the first treatment indicated for neurotrophic keratitis (NK), a rare and progressive eye disease that can lead to corneal scarring and visual loss. Oxervate is also the first-ever application of a human nerve growth factor (NGF) as drug or treatment.

The Patient Access Manager (PAM) will be responsible for supporting and maintaining patient support services that maximize access to our product for patients to whom it has been prescribed. The PAM will execute pre-defined strategies and role requirements to address patient access needs. The PAM will manage specific service levels and contribute to managing the performance of the team. The PAM will work with the team to improve existing materials as well as identify, design, and roll out patient access materials as needed. There is also an opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across the company, influence the development of the Patient Services organization, and shape the culture of Dompé US.

The Patient Access Manager will be accountable for abiding by the core values of our Dompé culture, which are Integrity, Speed, Knowledge, Passion, Attention to Detail, Reliability, Flexibility and Teamwork. ***Full-time, Temporary Position***

***Position Status:*** *This is a full-time, temporary position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension or transition to a permanent position based on program needs and funding availability. Extension or transition to permanent status is not guaranteed.*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Principal Program Coordinator (Coordinator)

**Reports To**: Prevention Program Manager

**Program Description:** The Prevention Education Program is a comprehensive substance use prevention program that includes 3 core interventions: Communities Mobilizing for Change on Alcoholism (CMCA), Strengthening Families Program (SFP), Botvin LifeSkills Program (LST) and outreach activities.

**Position Description:** The Coordinator will be trained and responsible for facilitating groups for the 3 core interventions (CMCA, LST, SFP) according to the contract requirements and program needs. * Other duties assigned by the Prevention Program Manager.

* Undergraduate degree in social sciences or related field and/or 2+ years experience providing direct services for youth.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate youth groups.
* Commitment to learn environmental prevention work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and juggle multiple competing deadlines/tasks in a fast paced environment.

* Experience using Zoom, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Classroom, etc.), Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and other relevant software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Job Requirements:**

* Must clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.

--------------------

Superpower is building a new health system to extend and enhance human life. We bring testing, personalized insights and ongoing care together to help people understand their health and take action earlier.

**About the role**

We’re looking for an Administrative Assistant & Office Operations Manager to help our CEO and executive team spend their time effectively and make our office a place where people can do their best work.

You’ll own executive support and day-to-day office operations, from inboxes, calendars and travel to daily lunch, team events and workplace improvements. This is a hands-on role for someone who anticipates needs, exercises good judgment and follows through without constant direction.

* **Travel and logistics.** Book flights, hotels and ground transportation, prepare itineraries and handle changes and related expenses.
* **Office operations and hospitality.** Run daily lunch and keep the office stocked, welcoming and working well. Manage vendors, maintenance and workplace improvements.
* **Events and office culture.** Plan team gatherings, celebrations and offsites. Build thoughtful routines and experiences that help people connect and feel part of the team.
* **Budgets and processes.** Track spending across office operations, meals, travel and events. Coordinate invoices and build simple systems that make recurring work reliable as the company grows.

* **Experience supporting senior leaders and running operations.** You’ve managed busy inboxes, calendars and competing requests, ideally alongside office responsibilities.

* Leaders have well-managed inboxes and calendars, arrive prepared and spend less time on administration.

* Spending is well managed, and recurring work runs through clear, dependable processes.

Berkeley Mills is a premier custom furniture and cabinetry manufacturer located in Berkeley, California. We specialize in designing and manufacturing exceptional kitchens, custom cabinetry, and fine furniture, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern design and manufacturing technology.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Kitchen Project Manager & Designer** to join our team. The ideal candidate has a strong background in kitchen and cabinetry design, proficiency in CAD software, and the ability to independently produce accurate design drawings. Experience preparing detailed cabinetry shop drawings is a significant advantage.

* Independently produce professional design drawings for client presentations, design approvals, and production coordination.
* Review and refine cabinetry layouts, dimensions, materials, finishes, and hardware specifications.
* Ensure kitchen designs meet functional, aesthetic, and dimensional requirements.
* Coordinate with our engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are practical, accurate, and ready for production.

**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary range for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is $186,600 - $252,400, with individual placement determined by your geographic location, experience, skills, and alignment with internal compensation standards. new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Tavus customers are building products and experiences with conversational AI. Getting from a signed contract to a successful deployment takes more than access to the platform. Customers need clear priorities, a workable implementation plan, and a partner who understands what they are trying to accomplish.

You will report to our Customer Lead and take ownership of an existing portfolio of customers, helping them move through implementation, adoption, and renewal. You will run the day-to-day relationship, coordinate technical partners, and keep customer commitments moving.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful independence. Your portfolio will include ongoing implementations and established customers between renewal cycles. You will inherit unfinished work, build trust with customers, and establish a clear plan for what happens next.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own your portfolio.** Build relationships with the people using, implementing, and buying Tavus. Understand their business objectives, success criteria, decision process, and reasons to renew.
* **Turn customer goals into working plans.** Establish milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision dates. For new customers, work with Sales and Customer Engineering to carry the buying context and agreed scope into onboarding. For existing customers, reconstruct missing context and reset the plan where needed.
* **Run dependable customer communication.** Acknowledge requests, clarify their impact, secure the right internal owner, and set the next update. Keep customers informed when answers or delivery dates change, without requiring them to chase.
* **Drive adoption and customer value.** Identify stalled implementations, weak engagement, and unrealized use cases. Determine whether the constraint is product quality, implementation, customer capacity, sponsorship, or fit, and coordinate a practical intervention.
* **Prioritize across accounts.** Allocate attention using customer impact, revenue, growth potential, urgency, and implementation complexity. Make tradeoffs explicit when competing requests exceed available capacity.
* **Coordinate technical work.** Give Customer Engineering, Support, Product, and Engineering useful context: what the customer is experiencing, what they have tried, what is blocked, and why it matters. Track the work through a verified answer or agreed next step.
* **Run renewal preparation and execution for assigned accounts.** Understand renewal intent early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, develop a recommendation, and coordinate the process through a decision. Partner with the Customer Lead and Sales on negotiation and commercial approvals.
* **Identify credible expansion opportunities.** Connect additional use cases to a buyer, a business outcome, and a feasible deployment path. Bring qualified opportunities to the appropriate commercial owner.
* **Maintain an actionable account record.** Keep the business objective, implementation status, usage, sponsor, risks, commitments, and next decision current. Distinguish progress from completion and customer interest from an agreed commitment.
* **Improve how we operate.** Turn recurring questions and successful interventions into reusable guidance, onboarding practices, and adoption and renewal playbooks. Surface product and documentation gaps with evidence of their customer impact.

**How ownership works**
-----------------------

You own the relationship, account plan, customer communication, and commercial readiness of your assigned portfolio. You are responsible for keeping work moving across teams and making unresolved decisions visible.

Customer Engineering owns technical implementation and troubleshooting. Product and Engineering own platform fixes and technical readiness. You work closely with those teams to establish owners, communicate confirmed capabilities and limitations, and agree on the next customer checkpoint.

When a request lacks an owner, a credible delivery plan, or an agreed scope, you escalate with the customer impact, options, and decision needed. You are comfortable setting expectations and explaining tradeoffs without promising work another team has not committed to deliver.

You will run routine account decisions independently within agreed priorities and commercial guidelines. Strategic escalations, pricing exceptions, and commitments beyond existing scope are handled with the Customer Lead and the relevant functional owner.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Experience independently managing a portfolio of B2B customers through implementation, adoption, and renewal.
* Experience with APIs, AI, infrastructure, developer tools, or another technical product where customer implementation materially affects success.
* The ability to enter an account with incomplete information, ask focused questions, and establish a coherent plan.
* Commercial judgment: you can connect product performance, usage, customer economics, sponsorship, and business value to retention and expansion.
* Strong follow-through across several accounts and internal teams. You keep commitments visible and recognize when a stalled next step requires a decision.
* Clear writing and sound judgment in difficult customer conversations. You communicate uncertainty honestly, bring bad news early, and adapt the detail to your audience.
* Enough technical fluency to understand an integration, gather useful evidence, and work credibly with engineers. Production software development is not a requirement.
* Evidence that you can prioritize competing demands, challenge an ineffective proposed solution, and set realistic expectations while maintaining trust.
* Comfort improving processes while using them. You can establish useful structure without waiting for a finished playbook.

We care about demonstrated ownership and judgment across these responsibilities. Relevant experience may come fro

**Role Overview**

A large e-commerce and logistics client is looking for a data-first program operator to own the analytics backbone of a fast-scaling energy and power planning function. This person manages large, complex datasets across hundreds to thousands of active sites in various stages of planning, due diligence, capital approval, and construction - translating raw data into decisions and building the tracking infrastructure the team runs on.

This is not a traditional program manager role. The core skillset is data - querying it, modeling it, centralizing it, and making it actionable. Strong operational discipline ensures that analytical outputs actually drive cross-functional alignment, risk visibility, and on-time delivery across PMO, Finance, Capital Management, Pre-Construction, and Construction stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

Own and maintain centralized trackers spanning the full site lifecycle - from demand forecasting and site selection through power due diligence, capital approval, utility engagement, and construction delivery

* - across a portfolio of hundreds to thousands of locations simultaneously
* Build and manage data models that integrate inputs from multiple internal and third-party sources into a single, reliable source of truth for portfolio health, risk, cost, and timeline status
* Design and stand up risk tracking frameworks that embed site-level due diligence outputs directly into downstream PMO and capital workflows, closing handoff gaps between site selection and delivery teams
* Produce executive-level reporting and dashboards that surface portfolio risk, cost variance, milestone status, and coverage gaps in real time
Identify data gaps, ownership ambiguities, and process breakdowns across stakeholder groups and build the mechanisms to fix them* - trackers, playbooks, operating rhythms, and escalation frameworks
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure utility infrastructure and interconnect costs flow accurately into capital approval budgets

* 5+ years in a data analyst or data-heavy program management role managing large, multi-variable datasets across complex portfolios

* Advanced Excel/Sheets and hands-on BI tool experience (Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight, or similar)
* SQL proficiency; Python a strong plus
* Proven ability to build centralized tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch across multiple stakeholder groups

new_jobs.description:
**Speedy Sticks** is a nationwide mobile phlebotomy company providing convenient, reliable blood collection services to patients in their homes and other designated locations. We work with healthcare providers, laboratories, research organizations, and other healthcare-related businesses to coordinate mobile specimen collection services throughout the United States.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Quality Assurance Specialist** to help maintain the accuracy, completeness, and quality of our mobile phlebotomy operations.

***Job Summary***

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for reviewing phlebotomists’ submitted appointment forms, service documentation, and other operational records to ensure that all required information is accurate, complete, and submitted according to company procedures.

This individual will identify errors, missing information, inconsistencies, and potential compliance issues, communicate with phlebotomists and internal team members to resolve deficiencies, and help improve the overall quality and efficiency of our services.

The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to identify problems before they affect patients, clients, or business operations.

***Key Responsibilities1. Submission Form Review & Quality Control***

* Review mobile phlebotomy submission forms for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company requirements.
* Verify that required fields, patient and appointment information, collection details, timestamps, and other applicable documentation are completed correctly.
* Identify missing information, incorrect entries, inconsistencies, illegible documentation, and incomplete submissions.
* Verify that required supporting documents, signatures, requisitions, and other applicable records are included when necessary.
* Flag incomplete or incorrect submissions and follow up with phlebotomists to obtain corrections.
* Track outstanding submissions and ensure deficiencies are resolved in a timely manner.
* Confirm that corrected forms meet company standards before marking them as complete.

***2. Phlebotomist Performance & Documentation Monitoring***

* Monitor the quality and consistency of documentation submitted by mobile phlebotomists.
* Identify recurring mistakes, documentation deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain records of submission errors and quality-related issues.
* Provide constructive feedback and communicate documentation requirements to phlebotomists.
* Escalate repeated errors, unresolved issues, or significant quality concerns to management.

***3. Compliance & Standard Operating Procedures***

* Ensure documentation follows Speedy Sticks' established procedures and applicable client requirements.
* Help maintain adherence to applicable privacy, confidentiality, specimen-handling documentation, and recordkeeping requirements.
* Identify potential compliance risks and escalate concerns to the appropriate manager.
* Help ensure that required documentation is handled securely and only accessed by authorized personnel.
* Support the consistent implementation of company quality standards and procedures.

***4. Specimen Collection & Service Quality***

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

If you enjoy building strong relationships, solving technical challenges, and making a meaningful impact for customers, this role is for you. Behind every major process facility is an EPC firm making high-stakes decisions about the equipment that will run it for decades.  
  
As FS-Elliott’s Account Manager for EPC Accounts across the Americas, you will be the trusted partner those firms rely on when compression is on the line, helping them identify the right integrally geared centrifugal compressor solutions and guiding them from early project stages through award, installation, and long-term support. You will collaborate across teams, travel throughout the region from Canada to South America, and play a central role in expanding FS-Elliott’s presence in these important markets.

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Own the EPC relationship. Serve as FS-Elliott’s primary contact for your EPC accounts and their end-user clients, and represent their requirements to our engineering, product management, and project teams.
* Win the specification. Engage EPC process and rotating equipment engineers at the front end of projects and position FS-Elliott solutions before the bid package is issued.
* Lead the pursuit. Build strategic sales plans for target projects, direct Sales Support through the quoting and bid process, and deliver technical presentations to current and prospective customers.
* Solve the hard applications. Partner with Product Management to develop alternative solutions when an application falls outside our standard product line.
* Close the deal. Negotiate orders and contracts alongside Finance, Legal, and Contracts Administration, identifying technical and commercial risks early and building mitigation plans.
* Stay with the customer. Coordinate with our Aftermarket team through installation and commissioning, and grow the relationship into long-term service and future project business.
* Know the market. Track EPC project activity and competitor offerings across the Americas, share market intelligence, contribute to product and process improvement, and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in Salesforce.

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* Experience selling engineered equipment, ideally rotating equipment or compressors, to EPC firms or industrial end users
* Working knowledge of how EPC projects are specified, bid, and awarded, including vendor qualification and technical bid evaluation
* A basic technical understanding of compressed air and gas compression systems, and the confidence to discuss it with engineers
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage customers with clarity and care
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and persuasion skills with sound business judgment
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach with the curiosity to understand challenges and find the right path forward
* A collaborative mindset focused on team and customer success, with the ability to work independently
* Dependability, integrity, and ownership in managing responsibilities and commitments
* The organization to manage multiple long-cycle pursuits and priorities while meeting deadlines
* Willingness to travel up to 50% to support customer relationships
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, ERP tools, and Salesforce CRM
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **About FS-Elliott**

FS-Elliott is a global leader in the engineering and manufacturing of oil-free, centrifugal compressors with operations in over 90 countries. Building on a 50-year tradition of excellence, we combine an unwavering commitment to quality with the desire for advancing technology to bring value to our customers, allowing them to increase their productivity and lower system operating costs.
